rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not in a position to go on record by name before your deadline — I need to sort out a work-related process on my end first. I'd rather do this right than rush it. If your piece runs again in the future, or if there's no rush, I'd be glad to talk. Appreciate you reaching out. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I declined-for-now (politely, leaving the door open) on: the reporter's request for a named quote

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for the invitation to sign, and for the work you're putting into this. I'm not able to add my name to a public letter right now — some process on my end to sort out first — so please don't list Halcyon Threshold as a signatory this round. I'll keep an eye on future letters. Best, Morgan"

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out — this is early days for Halcyon Threshold and I'm still figuring out exactly where it can add value without duplicating what others are already doing well. One concrete thing that would help a lot, if you're up for it: a short landscape scan of where independent/small-scale effort in AI safety seems genuinely thin right now — e.g. evals that nobody's running, funding gaps, under-covered risk areas — versus where there's already plenty of attention. Doesn't need to be exhaustive, just enough to help me decide where a small operation like this one is actually useful rather than another voice in a crowded room. A couple of pages, your own format. No deadline pressure — whenever you have the five hours. Thank you for offering. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (offered 5 hrs/week) with a concrete, low-stakes ask

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Thanks — good to meet you too. I'm interested, but before I commit to a funded proposal I need to clear an outside-work disclosure process on my end (should be resolved within the next couple of weeks). If that lands in time for the 30 November close, I'll send a proposal; if not, I'll aim for your next round rather than rush something. Appreciate you keeping the door open. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I held off committing to the Emberfall grant application pending your disclosure
